game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing, a woodcutter's clearing: the forest ranger must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the fairy lantern.
theme: Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing: a woodcutter's clearing
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: main and blocks: build a valid C source file that prints 12. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (3, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Finish both paths at their separate output depots. Deliver exactly 9 components (5 upper, 4 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 9.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Woodcutter Clearing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
